verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of Terraform's license terms or any open, vendor-neutral governance model, so there is nothing establishing protection against relicensing. The only on-topic community items point the other way: a contributor notes HashiCorp requires a CLA rather than a DCO (terraform-comm-4), and another reports months-long delays getting PRs merged (terraform-comm-11), both signs of single-vendor control. A 2021 comment praising HashiCorp for 'keeping it open source' (terraform-comm-7) is not a guarantee against future relicensing.
